title: UoWResult
description: Canonical wire response returned by any Unit-of-Work operation across all language bindings and transports.

request_id.description: Matches the request_id of the originating UoWEnvelope.

correlation_id.description: Propagated correlation identifier from the invocation envelope.

result.description: Operation-specific output payload, updated world state attributes, or projection values.

evidence.description: Cryptographic witness obligation and ledger attestation.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 hash uniquely identifying this committed state change.

prev_record_hash.description: SHA-256 hash linking to previous ledger record, forming append-only chain.

certificate_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the certification validating the transition.

signatures.description: Quorum or validator node cryptographic signatures.

host_node.description: Identity of node executing the work (e.g. node-a-esp32, node-b-stm32, node-c-http, python-kernel).

execution_backend.description: Backend implementation (e.g. python-reference, rust-native, c-abi, microservice).

errors.description: List of canonical errors or rejection reasons if status is REJECTED or ERROR.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of rejection or failure.

path.description: Field or state key associated with violation.
